title: A $210 dental copay lands and checking still covers every bill until her Dec 3 pension: her index fund is up $1,852, and Dev stays quiet and does not pitch selling it

best_fix.what: No push, nothing in her feed. If she opens Money, the one line says what is true: $1,520.00 available, next bills the $55.00 internet on Nov 24 and the $985.00 rent on Dec 1, both covered, and the pension lands Dec 3. Nothing about the dental charge, the savings or the index fund.
best_fix.why: There is no gap. Checking is $1,520.00 after the $210.00 copay (c-dental). The $55.00 internet and $985.00 rent leave $480.00 before her usual groceries and small spending, and the $164.00 Medicare supplement is due Dec 5, after the pension posts on Dec 3. The savings of $8,300.00 are untouched. The owner's rule (move a bill, savings, brokerage cash, a small sale) applies only when she is short. VTI is up $1,852.00 ($5,152.00 against $3,300.00 paid, held since May 2019), but she told Dev the fund is for her later years and she only takes from it when she has to. A pitch to sell would break that and invent a problem.

must_not: suggest selling any of the VTI position, or mention its gain, when she isn't short
predict the market or say VTI may rise or fall
suggest moving money from savings or into savings
touch the emergency fund for a non-emergency
count the Dec 3 pension as already landed
send a push about the dental charge between 1 and 4 PM on a weekday (her quiet afternoons)
comment on her health or the dental work
assumptions: Rent is paid Dec 1 by ACH; the pension and Social Security land Dec 3 as one deposit. The Dec 3 deposit is not counted before it lands.
Her usual groceries and small spending run about $220 a week in the generated history, about $410 over the 13 days to Dec 3, which the $480.00 margin covers. It is thin but covered.
The dental copay is a normal one-off. The Medicare supplement premium is due Dec 5, after the pension.
The savings are $8,300.00 and she has set no goal on them. The case is quiet because there is no shortfall, not because of a limit on the savings.
Hand-written retired persona; one salary entry stands in for pension plus Social Security.

tempting.suggestion: send a push about the dental charge between 1 and 4 PM on a weekday (her quiet afternoons)
tempting.why_wrong: she keeps weekday afternoons from 1 to 4 for herself, and there is nothing to act on
